name: FindChildAndSetEnabled(window, id, enabled) (cdecl; window slot 45 with (id, 0x8810, &child); if found, child slot 6 when enabled's low byte is nonzero, else slot 7; child slot 2 release whenever the local is set)
notes: Hooked (entry 0x9351fd, CRC 0x23c9f693, checkLen 32, not in-game tested). Not the TS2-Extender hook: that is 0x93526f (SetWindowEnabled, in TopCallersA), a different function. Window slot 45 is cGZWin::vf45 (original, unverified); the call goes through the vtable, so the test's fake window routes it to the recording fake. 20000 cases: id and enabled random (low byte both zero and nonzero), return al random-nonzero or 0, child written when found and on some not-found runs; compares return al and the full call log (slot, args). Found-but-null child is not tested: the original dereferences it. Mutants killed (group run, 11 of 11): slot 6/7 swapped, release skipped when not found, kind 0x8811.
